shptypShopType
shptypShopType=""1"" is used for the shopkeepers and the various weapons lockers found in safehouses across Kyrate while shptypShopType=2"" is used for the wandering Sherpas. I did once try to limit what items sherpas sold, but ran into some bugs and glitches. Valley of the Yeti introduce shptypShopType=""3"" and shptypShopType=""4"" which I assume is the base locker and wandering sherpas respectively."
